name: Divine Smite
summary: Expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage on a melee hit.
description: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8 for each slot level higher than 1st, to a maximum. The damage increases against undead or fiends as stated in the rules.
